dedupe_keys.name: a quantitative and qualitative evaluation of seismic retrofits according to the los angeles non ductile reinforced concrete buildings ordinance

description: A Quantitative and Qualitative Evaluation of Seismic Retrofits According to the Los Angeles Non-Ductile Reinforced Concrete Buildings Ordinance is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Kate Rhoades, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This research focuses on the progression of the Los Angeles non-ductile reinforced concrete evaluation and retrofitting ordinance. First, this study evaluated the performance of existing non-ductile concrete moment frame buildings constructed to different building standards. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: seismic retrofits, non-ductile reinforced concrete, earthquake, qualitative evaluation, quantitative evaluation, Los Angeles. Published 2026-04-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
